## Summary

What changes, and why?

## Evidence

Commands, fixture identifiers, or document paths that support the claim.
Summaries are not proof.

## Checklist

- [ ] `./Scripts/verify.sh` passes
- [ ] No credentials, transcripts, screenshots of secrets, or live endpoints
- [ ] No third-party source copied without a recorded license review
- [ ] Fixture or simulated material is labeled and not described as live
- [ ] Does not claim a runtime, installer, or integration that is not present
